pages: Aurora Smart Desk Lamp - Product Guide
The Aurora Smart Desk Lamp has a two-year limited warranty starting on the original purchase date.
A warranty claim requires the original purchase receipt.
The warranty covers defects in materials and workmanship.
It does not cover accidental damage, liquid damage, or repairs performed by an unauthorized service provider.
Unused lamps may be returned within 30 calendar days of purchase when they are in the original packaging.
After a returned lamp passes inspection, the refund is sent to the original payment method within five business days.
Electrical and Care Information
The power adapter accepts 100 to 240 volts AC and is rated at 24 watts.
The LED uses 12 watts and produces up to 800 lumens.
The lamp provides three color temperatures: 2700 K, 4000 K, and 5000 K.
The supported operating temperature is 0 to 40 degrees Celsius.
Clean the lamp with a soft, dry cloth. Do not use solvents or abrasive cleaners.
Customer support is available by email at support@aurora-example.com.
Connectivity and Troubleshooting
To enter pairing mode, hold the control button for five seconds until the indicator blinks blue.
To perform a factory reset, hold the control button for ten seconds until the indicator flashes red twice.
The lamp connects only to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi networks and does not support 5 GHz Wi-Fi.
Firmware updates are installed in the Aurora mobile app under Settings, Device, then Firmware.
The serial number is printed on the underside of the base and begins with the letters AUR.
